claims.claim: A site called pequalnp.com shows live updates on an AI agent swarm attempting to solve the P=NP math problem.
claims.episode_span: One swarm is trying to solve a super-hard math question called P=NP that has stumped people for decades, while another swarm is attempting something completely different: taking the Xbox version of GTA 6 and turning it into a PC game without permission.
claims.source_title: Two kinds of people watching agent swarms: P=NP vs GTA 6 port — Ethan Mollick (One Useful Thing)
claims.supporting_quote: Two kinds of people: those watching the agent swarm trying to crack P=NP and those watching the agent swarm trying to illegally port the Xbox version of GTA 6 to the PC. Here is the P=NP one: https://pequalnp.com/
